pages.title: Load and Light
pages.text: Load one heatable workpiece and furnace fuel, then ignite with Flint and Steel, Fire Starter, Fire Charge, or a supported igniter. The heating slot holds one loose item or one complete partly forged batch; the fuel slot remains stackable. Fuel insertion never lights a cold kiln.

pages.title: Carry the Heat
pages.text: One workpiece heats from cold to its item-defined maximum in about 30 seconds. Burning fuel maintains heat. Empty-hand use retrieves it for the anvil. Absolute Celsius temperature survives transfers, with cooling based on world time. Jade shows current/max temperature; Kilns do not require Bellows.

pages.title: Not a Furnace
pages.text: The kiln never smelts, fires pottery, or advances forge actions. It accepts forge ingredients and tagged heatable items. Glow and light show hot work. Retrieve an unfinished forging batch as a whole to reheat it. Its completed actions are preserved, and larger batches take proportionally longer to heat.
